name: Sanjunghogeol
source:
This is a visual novel about an ordinary college student who meets furries, characters rooted in traditional Korean culture, and experiences the events that unfold. In this game, you play as a college student living in a world where humans and furries coexist. As part of a research project for your studies, you travel to the mountains in search of ancient spirits that have lived there for centuries.

Along the way, you will meet the giant white tiger beastman Lee Taebaek, who has been the guardian of the mountain for 500 years; his successor, the black wolf spirit Yu Harang; and the youthful red fox beastman Yeon Juho. 

Experience their stories as you laugh, cry, and build romantic relationships.

[From [url=https://haetae-io.itch.io/sanjunghogeol]Itch.io[/url]]
